mapper.select: SELECT * FROM address WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY is_default DESC, create_time DESC
SELECT * FROM address WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND is_default = 1 LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO address (user_id, contact_name, contact_phone, province, city, district, detail_address, is_default, create_time) VALUES (#{userId}, #{contactName}, #{contactPhone}, #{province}, #{city}, #{district}, #{detailAddress}, #{isDefault}, NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE address SET contact_name = #{contactName}, contact_phone = #{contactPhone}, province = #{province}, city = #{city}, district = #{district}, detail_address = #{detailAddress} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM address WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.update: UPDATE address SET is_default = 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}
UPDATE address SET is_default = 0 WHERE user_id = #{userId}
